title: lycopodium obscurum subvar. proliferum
intro: Lycopodium obscurum subvar. proliferum, commonly known as "Fern Pine" or "Running Club Moss", is a type of spore-producing plant that belongs to the club moss family (Lycopodiaceae). The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory issues, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Lycopodium obscurum subvar. proliferum include its expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects, making it useful in treating conditions such as bronchitis, coughs, and colds. The bioactive constituents of the plant include lycopodium alkaloids, which have been shown to possess antimicrobial, antiviral, and antioxidant properties.
